summary: A-shares Stagflation, deep sector pullbacks vs extended Tech, HK global risk-on but outflow peg pressures: mean-reversion thesis alive but macro binds.
regime_read: China A-shares in confirmed Stagflation (growth -0.385, inflation +0.909) with neutral PBoC liquidity, growth-cyclical underperformance and small-cap weakness; the equity landscape shows extreme dispersion — Technology is a clear RS leader (+34.9% 60d, 73rd %ile), while many sectors (Autos, Banks, Healthcare, Staples, Media) are at deeply oversold 0–10th %iles. Hong Kong also sits in Stagflation but with slightly positive growth and global risk-on score of 0.423, driving extended RS in Financials (99.6th %ile), Exchanges, and Telecom, though the HKD peg is on the weak side (outflow) and breadth contradicts the headline growth signal. The domestic-driven A-share pain and global-liquidity-lifting HK fit the working thesis, but the lack of PBoC easing amid falling growth could delay mean-reversion.
conflicts: Stagflation quad with neutral liquidity: no easing despite negative growth weakens the case for a sharp domestic equity bounce, even from oversold levels.
A-share Technology is extended (60d +34.9%) as a momentum leader but the stagflation macro suggests it may be overbought and vulnerable to reversal, yet no immediate catalyst.
Hong Kong risk-on score + extended Financials vs. weak-side peg and outflows: rising USD/global risk-on lifts HK, but a reversal in either could trigger a sharp unwind of those extended positions.
HK growth score slightly positive vs. contracting breadth and outflow peg — the headline growth confirmation may be masking underlying weakness that could surface.
rotation_check: Reality tracks the thesis: A-shares are mean-reverting in the aggregate (many sectors deeply down), supporting the premise that RS leaders are extended and deep-pullback names offer higher-odds short-term setups. Hong Kong is riding global risk appetite — Financials and Tech at extreme percentiles — consistent with the idea that HK relies more on global risk and the US dollar. Divergence appears in the severity: HK also has oversold pockets (Auto & EV 0.8th %ile, Gaming 0.4th %ile), so even there limited local flows create mean-reversion candidates, but the primary driver remains global risk-on.
transmission: If US growth premium pushes USD higher, HKD peg outflows intensify, pressuring HK’s extended Financials and Exchanges.
A lack of PBoC easing while growth scores stay negative keeps stagflation fears alive, capping any A-share bounce from oversold extremes.
Commodity Goldilocks and firm USD/CNY at 6.757 support resource sectors like Coal/Nonferrous in A-shares, but these are only mid-high RS and not heavily oversold.
Any global risk-off shock would hit HK extended leaders harder than A-shares, reverting the recent HK outperformance relative to the mainland.
watch_items: PBoC liquidity shift — any move from neutral to easing would alter the stagflation headwind for A-shares.
A-share Technology 20d momentum (now +8.8%) — a break below zero would signal the start of mean-reversion in the leader.
US core PCE/inflation data that could shift the US Goldilocks backdrop and HK global risk score.
USD/CNY level — a break back above 6.85 or below 6.70 would signal shift in CNY flow support/headwind for A-shares.
HK peg distance widening beyond 0.85% toward the weak-side boundary, triggering outflow acceleration and potential intervention noise.

zh.summary: A股滞胀，板块深度回调 vs 科技股延伸，港股全球风险偏好但流出与联系汇率压力：均值回归逻辑尚存但宏观约束。
zh.regime_read: 中国A股确认滞胀（增长-0.385，通胀+0.909），央行流动性中性，增长周期板块表现不佳，小盘股疲弱；股市呈现极端分化——科技股是明确的相对强弱领导者（60日+34.9%，73百分位），而许多板块（汽车、银行、医疗、消费必需品、媒体）处于深度超卖的0-10百分位。港股同样处于滞胀但增长略为正，全球风险偏好评分0.423，推动金融（99.6百分位）、交易所和电信板块相对强弱延伸，但港元联系汇率偏弱（资金外流），广度与整体增长信号相矛盾。内需驱动的A股阵痛与全球流动性推升的港股符合当前逻辑，但在增长下滑背景下央行未放松政策可能延迟均值回归。
zh.rotation_check: 现实符合逻辑：A股整体呈现均值回归（许多板块深度下跌），支持相对强弱领先者已延伸而深度回调个股提供短期胜率较高机会的观点。港股正搭乘全球风险偏好——金融和科技板块处于极端百分位，与港股更依赖全球风险及美元的观点一致。分歧在于严重程度：港股也存在超卖板块（汽车与电动车0.8百分位，游戏0.4百分位），因此即便当地有限资金流也创造均值回归候选标的，但主要驱动因素仍是全球风险偏好。
conflicts: 滞胀象限叠加中性流动性：增长为负却无宽松政策，削弱了国内股市即使从超卖水平大幅反弹的理由。
A股科技板块作为动量领先者已延伸（60日+34.9%），但滞胀宏观环境表明其可能超买并面临回调风险，然而缺乏立即催化剂。
港股风险偏好评分较高+金融板块延伸 vs 联系汇率偏弱与资金外流：美元走强/全球风险偏好提升港股，但两者之一逆转可能触发这些延伸头寸的急剧平仓。
香港增长指数小幅正值，但广度收缩且存在资金流出压力——表面上的增长确认可能掩盖了潜在疲弱，这些疲弱可能最终显现。
transmission: 如果美国增长溢价推高美元，港元联系汇率制度下的资金流出将加剧，从而对香港估值已高的金融和交易所板块构成压力。
在增长指数仍为负值的情况下，中国央行缺乏宽松政策持续引发滞胀担忧，限制了A股从超卖极端水平出现的任何反弹。
大宗商品的‘金发女孩’行情以及美元/人民币汇率在6.757的坚挺水平，支撑了A股中的煤炭/有色金属等资源板块，但这些板块的RS仅处于中高水平，并未严重超卖。
任何全球性的避险冲击对香港估值已高的领涨股的打击将大于A股，从而逆转近期港股相对于内地的优异表现。
watch_items: 中国央行流动性转向——任何从中性转为宽松的举措都将改变A股面临的滞胀逆风。
A股科技20日动量（当前+8.8%）——跌破零轴将标志着领涨板块均值回归的开始。
美国核心PCE/通胀数据可能改变美国金发女孩背景以及香港全球风险评分。
美元/人民币汇率水平——重新突破6.85或跌破6.70将标志着人民币资金流对A股的支持/阻力发生转变。
香港联系汇率制度距离扩大至0.85%以上并接近弱方兑换保证，引发资金外流加速及潜在干预噪音。
